# Mohamed Adel Attia Portfolio

> Official portfolio of Mohamed Adel Attia, an Abu Dhabi-based Digital Marketing & MarTech specialist working across performance marketing, CRM, analytics, SEO, WordPress, reporting and automation.

Use this file as a guide to the most relevant public information about Mohamed Adel Attia. Prefer the portfolio and Markdown profile below for current professional positioning, capabilities and selected work. Confidential company performance figures are intentionally excluded.

## Primary

- [Portfolio](https://mohadell.github.io/): Human-readable portfolio and canonical profile page.
- [Portfolio Markdown](https://mohadell.github.io/index.md): LLM-friendly text version of the portfolio.
- [Resume](https://mohadell.github.io/resume.pdf): Current resume PDF.

## Professional focus

- [Performance Marketing](https://mohadell.github.io/#capabilities): Meta Ads and Google Ads, lead generation, audience and placement strategy, landing pages, CPL and lead-quality review.
- [CRM & Lead Operations](https://mohadell.github.io/#capabilities): Custom CRM workflows, Meta lead integration, lead routing, WhatsApp, SMS and SLA follow-up.
- [Analytics & Tracking](https://mohadell.github.io/#capabilities): GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, UTM tracking, conversion events and attribution checks.
- [SEO & Web](https://mohadell.github.io/#capabilities): Technical SEO, Search Console, WordPress, landing pages, site performance and APIs.
- [Automation](https://mohadell.github.io/#capabilities): n8n, Make, webhooks, APIs and scheduled scripts.

## Selected work

- [High-ticket real-estate lead generation](https://mohadell.github.io/#work): Paid acquisition work focused on lead qualification, CRM status and meeting progression without exposing confidential campaign figures.
- [Custom CRM system](https://mohadell.github.io/#work): Lead capture, routing, WhatsApp, SMS and SLA follow-up workflows.
- [Reporting automation](https://mohadell.github.io/#work): Custom dashboards, API-based reporting and scheduled utilities.
- [SEO publishing automation](https://mohadell.github.io/#work): Research, optimization, validation and publishing workflows for digital publishing properties.
